narr: A stationary area of thunderstorms led to excessive rainfall in and near Woodward, Oklahoma with some areas receiving over 5 inches of rain. Flash flooding was reported in portions of Woodward.
ev: Many streets with one to two feet of water. Some areas impassable with up to 3 to 5 inches of rain measured across Woodward.
lsr: MANY STREETS WITH ONE TO TWO FEET OF WATER, SOME AREAS IMPASSABLE. 3 TO 5 INCHES OF RAIN MEASURED ACROSS WOODWARD.
